name: Raspberry Pi Pico 2
description: $5 RP2350 successor to the Pico: dual Cortex-M33 or Hazard3 RISC-V at 150 MHz, 520 KB SRAM and 4 MB flash in the same breadboard-friendly castellated format.
notes: Pin-compatible with Pico 1; the RP2350A on board exposes 26 GPIO (GP0-22, GP26-28) and 3 usable ADC channels (ADC3 senses VSYS).
Boards built with RP2350 A2 silicon have erratum E9 (internal pull-downs can leave inputs high; use external pull-downs of 8.2 kOhm or less); the A4 stepping fixes it - check the chip marking.
Micro-USB; Pico 2 W adds WiFi/Bluetooth, Pimoroni Pico Plus 2 adds PSRAM and 16 MB flash.
